setup.title: Set up the vault
setup.description: The vault encrypts the passwords and keys of your sites. Choose a master password you will remember: it cannot be reset without the recovery kit.

unlock.title: Unlock the vault
unlock.description: Enter your master password to use the saved credentials in this session.

kit.title: Save your recovery kit
kit.description: This is the only way back in if you forget the master password. It is shown once: store it somewhere safe and offline.

errors.invalid_secret: The master password is not right.
errors.vault_not_initialized: The vault is not set up yet.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

locked.title: Your vault is locked
locked.save: Passwords and keys are sealed with the vault, so it has to be unlocked to save them. Editing other settings and quick connections do not need it.
locked.connect: The password of this site is sealed in your vault. Unlock it with your master password to connect.
locked.team: The key of a team is sealed with your vault. Unlock it to create the team.
locked.export: The secrets of the sites are sealed with your vault. Unlock it to export them.

missing.title: Set up your vault
missing.save: Passwords and keys are sealed with a vault protected by a master password. Create it to save them; quick connections do not need it.
missing.connect: This site has a saved password, but you have no vault yet. Create one to connect.
missing.team: The key of a team is sealed with your vault. Create your vault to start a team.
missing.export: Exporting takes the secrets out of your vault, and you have none yet. Create it first.

notice.quickHint: Quick connections do not need the vault.
